summary.text: Paul Bailey is a Republican state senator from Sparta who represents Tennessee Senate District 15 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A trucking business owner and small farmer, he chairs the Senate Commerce and Labor Committee.

paragraphs.text: Paul Bailey was born on March 4, 1968, is married and has three children, according to the Tennessee General Assembly.
He attended Tennessee Tech University and lists his occupations as trucking and small farming.
Ballotpedia describes him as the owner of CB Trucking.
Bailey served on the White County Commission and, per Ballotpedia, resigned that post when he was appointed to the state House of Representatives.
He has been a member of the Senate from the 109th through the 114th General Assemblies.
He chairs the Senate Commerce and Labor Committee and is a member of the Fiscal Review and Senate Transportation and Safety committees.
